title: Teaching himself by playing along with records
summary: He taught himself by playing along with records such as Mamie Smith and the Jazz Hounds, using a trombone his brothers had left in the house.

bands.name: Mamie Smith and the Jazz Hounds

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Three years. He couldn't have taught me. No, I taught my own self. I used to play with the records. We would get a new record about once a year, so in a whole year I could learn everything anybody played on it! You know? [LAUGHS]

I liked the Mamie Smith records. Mamie Smith and the Jazz Hounds. And...oh, there was quite a... Fletcher Henderson at the piano and... I used to listen to every instrument, you know. I was very interested in the way they sounded.

Yeah, there was a trombone in my house. My brother used to play on it, yeah. I had another brother that used to play on it. And he stopped playing on it, found something else to do. So I would pick it up now and then and play with the record; you know, just try and play what I heard.
You said you got a new record about once a year. So playing the phonograph wasn't much of... You just happened to have a phonograph that was not being used all the time.
